title: Operational Readiness & Compliance QA Matrix for Private Deploys
author: Priya Narang
body:
Overview

Purpose:
This document provides a single-source QA matrix that combines operational acceptance criteria and compliance evidence required to commission a Redwood Private deployment (VPC or on-prem). It is intended for deployment operators, field engineers, and security/compliance reviewers.

Scope:
- Applies to production-bound Private deployments (VPC and on-prem appliances).
- Covers pre-delivery validation, day-0 commissioning, post-install acceptance, and upgrade/rollback gating for stateful services (runtime, KV cache, control plane).
- Does NOT replace customer-specific legal/compliance contracts; it maps to evidence artifacts used during audits.

Quick summary (one-line):
A checklist-driven matrix that maps checks -> acceptance criteria -> test steps -> evidence artifact -> owner -> rollback/mitigation.

Acceptance Matrix (table)
| Check ID | Domain | Acceptance Criteria | Test / Command | Evidence artifact | Owner | Pass Condition | Rollback Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OR-01 | Network & Connectivity | Tenant control-plane connectivity verified; all control plane endpoints reachable from customer subnets (e2e RTT < 150ms internal) | curl -sS https://controlplane.internal/healthz -H 'X-Env: prod' | controlplane-health-20260602.json (operator bundle) | Network Eng | 200 OK + health=ok | Failed probe 3x / 5m |
| OR-02 | API Latency | P95 inference latency for representative smoke prompt < 700ms for small models, < 1500ms for large models under baseline load | promql: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) | prometheus/snapshots/p95-latency-20260602.png | Runtime | Meets thresholds for target instance type | P95 > threshold for 10m and error rate increase > 0.5% |
| OR-03 | Error Rate | 5xx rate < 0.5% during acceptance test window (30m) | promql: sum(rate(redwood_inference_errors_total{code=~"5.."}[30m])) / sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[30m])) | prometheus/alerts/error-rate-20260602.txt | SRE | <0.5% | >1% sustained 10m |
| OR-04 | KV Cache Consistency | KV cache hit ratio > 60% for warm workload; no divergent keys across replicas | promql: sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) | kv-cache-audit-20260602.csv | Runtime | Hit ratio >= 60% | Cache divergence detected during validation |
| OR-05 | Disk & Snapshot Integrity | Stateful storage snapshots complete and checksum-verified within window | sha256sum on snapshot artifacts; verify store manifest checksums | snapshots/checksums-20260602.txt | Storage | All checksums match | Missing/invalid checksums |
| OR-06 | Telemetry & Audit Logging | Required events emitted and stored in customer-bound telemetry stream for 90 days; audit logs contain operator actions with UID | sample query: logs_query('service:controlplane AND event:operator_action') | telemetry/evidence/operator-log-sample-20260602.json | Observability | Event sample present and searchable | Missing critical events |
| OR-07 | Secrets & Key Management | KMS binding verified; rotations succeed in test mode without service interruption | kms: simulate-rotate --dry-run --tenant T123 | kms/rotation-report-20260602.txt | Security | Rotation dry-run completes, services remain healthy | Rotation causes auth failures |
| OR-08 | SLO & SLA Mapping | Per-tenant SLOs configured in control plane (latency/error budgets) and exported to billing | controlplane-cli get-slo --tenant T123 | controlplane/configs/slo-config-20260602.yaml | Product Ops | Config present and matches contract | SLO mismatch with contract |
| OR-09 | Compliance Evidence | Data residency, retention policies and access logs are populated and exportable per customer policy | export_evidence --customer C456 --range 2026-05-01:2026-06-01 | compliance/evidence-bundle-C456-20260602.zip | Security | Evidence bundle contains required docs | Evidence incomplete |
| OR-10 | Upgrade/Rollback Safety | Upgrade dry-run shows no KV state loss and automated rollback completes within 15 minutes on failure | upgrade-simulate --dry-run --step model-swap | upgrade/reports/upgrade-dryrun-20260602.txt | Release Eng | Dry-run passes and rollback tested | Dry-run fails or rollback cannot complete |

Operational test procedures (numbered)
1. Preflight network validation (OR-01):
   - Verify BGP/peering routes, NSG/ACL rules per deployment template.
   - Run control-plane /healthz and confirm 200/OK from 3 customer subnets.
   - Collect traceroute from two AZs and attach to evidence bundle.

2. Baseline latency & error sweep (OR-02, OR-03):
   - Deploy a representative load generator (k6 script) using customer load profile (10rps -> 100rps ramp).
   - Run for 30 minutes while collecting metrics; capture p50/p95/p99 and 5xx rates.
   - Required: p95 <= thresholds in acceptance matrix; 5xx < 0.5%.

3. KV cache & model stability (OR-04):
   - Warm the runtime with canonical prompt set (appendix: 'warm-prompts.json').
   - Measure hit ratio over a 10-minute steady window; verify replica alignment using kv-check utility.

4. Snapshot & restore verify (OR-05):
   - Create on-demand snapshot, copy to staging, validate SHA256 checksums, and attempt a restore to an isolated tenant.

5. Telemetry ingestion and sampling (OR-06):
   - Emit synthetic operator actions and model loads; run search queries against telemetry backend to prove retention and indexing.

6. KMS dry-rotate and secrets check (OR-07):
   - Execute KMS dry-rotate. Validate that SDKs can fetch keys and tokens are still valid post-rotation.

7. SLO configuration audit (OR-08):
   - Use controlplane-cli to export tenant SLOs and reconcile with the contractual SLO matrix.

8. Compliance evidence export (OR-09):
   - Run evidence export tooling; perform spot-checks on exported access logs, data residency metadata, and retention timestamps.

9. Upgrade dry-run & rollback validation (OR-10):
   - Run the full upgrade-simulate in a staging copy of the tenant state. Intentionally inject a failure at 'model swap' step and validate the automated rollback completes and returns the system to the prior steady-state within 15 minutes. Record the rollback timeline and artifacts.

Acceptance artifacts and naming conventions
- Evidence bundles should be uploaded to the deployment S3 path: s3://redwood-deploy-evidence/<customer>/<deploy-id>/ and include the following files exactly: 
  - <deploy-id>-controlplane-health.json
  - <deploy-id>-prom-p95.png
  - <deploy-id>-kv-audit.csv
  - <deploy-id>-snapshot-checksums.txt
  - <deploy-id>-telemetry-sample.json
  - <deploy-id>-kms-rotation-report.txt
  - <deploy-id>-upgrade-dryrun.txt
- Naming convention is required so compliance automation can link artifacts to tickets.

Prometheus & log queries (examples)
- P95 latency by model (5m):
  histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
- 5xx rate (30m):
  sum(rate(redwood_inference_errors_total{code=~"5.."}[30m])) / sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[30m]))
- KV cache hit ratio (5m):
  sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))
- Telemetry sample query (logs):
  service=\"controlplane\" AND event=\"operator_action\" AND tenant=\"T123\" | limit 100

Rollout gating, escalation, and rollback policy
- Gating rules before landing into production tenant: all OR-0x checks must be PASS.
- Soft gates (warnings) may be accepted by Product Ops with explicit temp SLO relaxation and an open remediation ticket.
- Hard gates (network failure, KMS failure, evidence missing) must block release and trigger an automated rollback if the gate is crossed during a live upgrade.
- Rollback policy: automated rollback is initiated when any of these occur within the upgrade window:
  - P95 latency > 2x target for > 5 minutes
  - 5xx error rate spike > 2% sustained for > 5m
  - Snapshot checksum mismatch detected
  - KMS auth failures observed in telemetry
- Rollback playbook steps (top-level):
  1. Pause incoming traffic via controlplane traffic-shield.
  2. Trigger rollback orchestration (orchestrator rollback --deploy <deploy-id>).
  3. Verify KV store and snapshot consistency.
  4. Re-enable traffic to previous release and monitor for 30 minutes.
  5. Open postmortem ticket and schedule follow-up fixes.

SLOs and monitoring thresholds (recommended defaults)
- API latency: p95 <= 700ms (small models), <= 1500ms (large models)
- Error budget: < 0.5% 5xx during acceptance window
- KV cache hit ratio: >= 60% after warmup (10m)
- Snapshot completion: full snapshot within replication window (<= 20 minutes)
- Operator action audit logs: present and searchable within 5 minutes of action

Owner map and escalation contacts
- Runtime (latency, cache): oncall-runtime@redwood.internal (Pager: #runtime-oncall)
- Control plane & SLOs: platform-sre@redwood.internal
- Network: infra-network@redwood.internal
- Security/KMS: sec-ops@redwood.internal
- Release & upgrade: release-eng@redwood.internal

Appendix A — Sample CLI snippets
- Health check (control plane):
  curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" https://controlplane.internal/healthz | jq .

- Upgrade dry-run (example):
  ./redwood-cli upgrade-simulate --deploy-id DPL-20260602 --steps model-swap,kv-migrate --dry-run --output upgrade/reports/upgrade-dryrun-20260602.txt

- KV audit tool (example):
  ./kv-check --replica-a http://replica-a:8080 --replica-b http://replica-b:8080 --report kv-cache-audit-20260602.csv

Appendix B — Warm prompts (summary)
- warm-prompts.json contains 50 canonical prompts representative of customer traffic: short-chat, code-completion, embedding queries. Use warm-prompts.json --concurrency 40 for baseline warming.

Appendix C — Evidence retention & handoff
- Evidence retention rules: keep deployment evidence for minimum 3 years for regulated customers; obfuscate PII before bundling.
- Handoff: once PASS, upload evidence bundle and mark the deployment ticket as READY_FOR_CUTOFF. Security will sign-off and issue the deployment certificate.
